articles.title: Azimuth Sells Bronx Educational Facility to Equality Charter School for $55M
articles.narrative: Azimuth Development Group has sold an educational facility at 801 Bartholdi Street in the East Bronx to Equality Charter School for $54.5 million. The 63,000-square-foot property, completed in 2025, will serve as an elementary school capable of accommodating 900 students. The facility includes two cafeterias, a gymnasium, and rooftop recreational space.

data_points.address: 801 Bartholdi Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: The facility includes two cafeterias, a gymnasium, and 6,000 square feet of recreational space on the rooftop, designed to accommodate 900 students.
data_points.project_notes: The property appears to have been a build-to-suit construction job for Azimuth Development Group.

articles.title: Arc Capital Lands $29M Refi for Chapman Market in L.A.’s Koreatown
articles.narrative: Arc Capital Partners has secured a $29.3 million refinancing loan for Chapman Market, a historic retail and dining property in Los Angeles' Koreatown. Voya Investment Management provided the financing for the 41,241-square-foot asset, which is a prominent multi-tenant center known for its vibrant nightlife and Korean food concepts. The property, originally built in 1928, was designated a Los Angeles Historic-Cultural Monument and was acquired by Arc Capital a decade ago.

data_points.address: 3465 West Sixth Street, Los Angeles, CA
data_points.notable_features: Historic-Cultural Monument; multi-tenant dining, retail, and entertainment center with a concentration of Korean food and specialty concepts.
data_points.project_notes: Property previously acquired by Arc Capital Partners 10 years ago for $30 million; secured a $25.5 million bridge loan in 2021.

articles.title: In Health Care Real Estate, Creativity Abounds — It Has To
articles.narrative: This article summarizes key discussions from Commercial Observer's National Healthcare Forum, where capital planning executives, legal experts, construction managers, and project leaders convened to address the evolving landscape of healthcare real estate. Experts emphasized the need for creative strategies in funding and improving aging infrastructure, moving from reactive maintenance to proactive master planning. Discussions highlighted challenges such as regulatory pressures, accelerated project timelines, and the shift towards outpatient services requiring more convenient, community-based locations. A central theme was the importance of infrastructure resiliency and involving the right stakeholders early in the planning process to minimize operational disruptions.

articles.title: Andreessen Horowitz to Open West Palm Office for Defense-Tech Bets
articles.narrative: Andreessen Horowitz, a prominent venture capital firm, has signed a lease for a new office in West Palm Beach, FL, at Related Ross' CityPlace Tower. This new regional headquarters will house the firm's $1.18 billion American Dynamism fund, focusing on defense-tech investments and is slated to open early next year. The transaction further solidifies West Palm Beach's growing reputation as a tech and finance hub, a transformation driven by Related Ross' significant development initiatives in the area.

data_points.address: 525 Okeechobee Boulevard, West Palm Beach, FL
data_points.project_notes: The building was purchased by Stephen Ross for $175 million in 2021.

articles.title: Longpoint Buys Miami-Dade Warehouse Portfolio for $195M
articles.narrative: Longpoint Partners has acquired a 10-building industrial portfolio in Miami-Dade County for $195 million. The portfolio, comprising small-bay properties, totals 729,901 square feet across 41 acres and is 90 percent leased to a diverse tenant base. This acquisition aligns with Longpoint's strategy of securing functional, well-located industrial assets in supply-constrained markets.

data_points.notable_features: Small-bay properties with clear heights ranging from 17 to 25 feet.

articles.title: Gardner Tanenbaum Completes $60M Adaptive Reuse Project in Downtown Oklahoma City
articles.narrative: Gardner Tanenbaum Holdings has completed The Harlow, a $60 million adaptive reuse project in downtown Oklahoma City. The project transformed two historic buildings, the Tradesmen National Bank building and the Medical Arts building, both constructed in the early 1920s, into a 265-unit apartment complex with additional retail space. The property offers a variety of unit types and a comprehensive amenity package.

data_points.address: 101 N. Broadway / 100 Park Ave., Oklahoma City, OK
data_points.notable_features: Adaptive reuse of two historic buildings from the early 1920s, includes retail space and amenities such as a game room, fitness center, movie theater, bowling alley, and coworking space.

articles.title: Marcus & Millichap Brokers Sale of 299-Unit Self-Storage Facility in Crowley, Texas
articles.narrative: Marcus & Millichap has facilitated the sale of Crowley Space Station, a 299-unit self-storage facility situated south of Fort Worth, Texas. The property, spanning 5.2 acres and offering 64,210 net rentable square feet, was sold by a local owner-operator to a California-based private investor. The transaction highlights continued investor interest in the self-storage sector.

data_points.notable_features: Offers drive-up units, covered parking, and uncovered parking spaces.

articles.title: Sansone Group Delivers 269,700 SF Industrial Building in Midlothian, Texas
articles.narrative: Sansone Group has completed Palmer Logistics, a 269,700-square-foot industrial facility in Midlothian, Texas. The build-to-suit project, developed for Palmer International, will serve as a hazardous materials storage and distribution center. ARCO/Murray was the general contractor for the project, which broke ground in August 2025.

data_points.notable_features: Facility designed for hazardous materials storage and distribution.

articles.title: Oxford Partners Negotiates 10,709 SF Industrial Lease Renewal, Expansion in Northwest Houston
articles.narrative: Oxford Partners has successfully negotiated a 10,709-square-foot industrial lease renewal and expansion in northwest Houston. The brokerage firm represented the tenant, a contract mover services company, in the transaction. The landlord, Bleecker Partners, was represented by Stream Realty Partners.

articles.title: SL Green Sells Lower Manhattan Office Building for $226M
articles.narrative: SL Green Realty Corp. has sold The SoHo Building, a 223,000-square-foot office property in Lower Manhattan, for $226 million. The 13-story building, originally constructed between 1908 and 1920, was later combined into a single structure. The buyer of the asset was not disclosed.

data_points.address: 110 Greene Street, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Originally constructed as two structures between 1908 and 1920, later combined into a single 13-story building.

articles.title: Cadence McShane Construction Company wins Multifamily Project of the Year at REDnews Real Estate Awards
articles.narrative: Cadence McShane Construction Company's Westgrove project was honored as Multifamily Project of the Year at the 2026 Texas REDnews Real Estate Awards. Developed for McNair Interests, this mixed-use community in Houston features 371 apartment units, a ground-level café, and a comprehensive amenity package. The design by The Preston Partnership incorporates five stories of wood-frame construction around a five-level parking garage.

data_points.notable_features: Mixed-use community with a 2,000-square-foot ground-level café, extensive amenity package including a rooftop sky deck, coworking pods, pet spa, two-story fitness center, resort-style swimming pool, and dog park. Located near White Oak Bayou and Heights Hike and Bike Trails, with proximity to Downtown Houston.

articles.title: Lee & Associates closes 14,535-square-foot industrial lease in Mesquite
articles.narrative: Lee & Associates Dallas-Fort Worth recently facilitated a new industrial lease for a 14,535-square-foot space in Mesquite, Texas. The transaction involved Big FP Property, LLC as the landlord and GC Central Supply as the tenant.

articles.title: Crescent Communities planning 313-unit multifamily community for West Nashville
articles.narrative: Crescent Communities is planning a new 313-unit multifamily community named NOVEL oneC1TY in West Nashville. The project, envisioned as "Nashville's Modern Social Club," will be part of the larger oneC1TY mixed-use development and is designed with a focus on healthy living and community, featuring ample green space and direct access to existing retail, dining, and office destinations. The development will replace the C1TYBLOX retail and sand volleyball village, with plans to incorporate beloved elements of C1TYBLOX into the new community's ground-floor retail and public plaza.

data_points.notable_features: Designed as "Nashville's Modern Social Club" with a focus on health and wellness, featuring a resort-style rooftop pool deck, bar with sand volleyball, fitness center, courtyard with fire pits, and a Sky Lounge with Nashville skyline views. It will include 5,000 square feet of ground-floor retail and a public plaza.
data_points.project_notes: The project site currently houses C1TYBLOX, a retail and sand volleyball village constructed from repurposed shipping containers, which will continue to operate through the end of the year before redevelopment begins. The development is part of the larger oneC1TY mixed-use destination.

articles.title: Berkadia closes sale of 160-unit seniors housing property in Evanston
articles.narrative: Berkadia Seniors Housing & Healthcare has brokered the sale of Trulee Evanston, a 160-unit Class-A senior living community in Evanston, IL. AEW Capital Management sold the property to a national REIT, with Solera Senior Living continuing as the operator. The transaction highlights strong institutional investor interest in high-quality, stabilized seniors housing assets located in markets with limited supply and favorable demographics.

data_points.notable_features: Nine-story community offering 127 independent living/assisted living units and 33 memory care units, with amenities including chef-prepared dining, a ninth-floor Skyline Club, fitness and wellness spaces, an outdoor courtyard, theater, art studio, concierge services, local transportation and on-site salon services. Located near downtown Evanston, Northwestern University, healthcare providers, retail, dining and public transportation.

articles.title: AmTrustRE Completes 360 Lexington Avenue Repositioning
articles.narrative: AmTrustRE has completed a comprehensive modernization and repositioning of 360 Lexington Avenue, a 268,000-square-foot office building in Manhattan. The project, led by MdeAS Architects, aimed to transform the mid-century modern property into a contemporary, hospitality-focused workplace. The repositioning enhances the building's appeal for next-generation office users, capitalizing on its prime location near Grand Central and Midtown's business district.

data_points.address: 360 Lexington Avenue, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Mid-century modern style building with a new double-height storefront and angular metal panels.
data_points.project_notes: AmTrustRE acquired the property in late 2024.

articles.title: Hudson Pacific Extends Maturity on $1.1B Hollywood Media Loan
articles.narrative: Hudson Pacific Properties and its joint venture partner have successfully extended the maturity of their $1.1 billion CMBS loan for the Hollywood Media Portfolio to November 9, 2027. The extension maintains the existing interest rate and does not require any principal paydown at closing. This move provides the owners with additional time and flexibility to advance their leasing strategy across the portfolio and proactively manage their debt maturity schedule.

data_points.notable_features: Includes Sunset Gower Studios, Sunset Las Palmas Studios, Sunset Bronson Studios, and five Class A office properties (ICON, EPIC, Harlow, 6040 Sunset, CUE).
data_points.project_notes: The loan's maturity was extended to November 9, 2027, with no change to the interest rate and no principal paydown required at closing. The portfolio includes rights to build an additional 1.1 million square feet of office and production space.

articles.title: Friedman’s Restaurant Expands with Upper West Side Location
articles.narrative: The ownership group behind Friedman's Restaurant has acquired a 5,000-square-foot retail cooperative unit on Manhattan's Upper West Side for $4.135 million. The new owners plan to open a new Friedman's Restaurant location in an existing vacant space within the property, while two long-standing neighborhood businesses will continue to operate. This acquisition allows the restaurant group to expand its presence in a prime Upper West Side location.

data_points.address: 541-555 Amsterdam Ave, New York City, NY
data_points.notable_features: Retail cooperative unit on Manhattan's Upper West Side.
data_points.project_notes: The property currently houses two existing businesses, Barney Greengrass and Hudson & Charles, which will remain in operation.

articles.title: Industry Experts on the Challenges, Opportunities in Western Industrial Market (VIDEO)
articles.narrative: This article summarizes expert opinions from the Connect Industrial West 2026 event regarding the current state of the industrial market. Industry leaders highlighted the competitive landscape for landlords, noting that tenants often have numerous options, necessitating quick action to secure deals. The discussion covered both the challenges and opportunities within the Western industrial market, drawing insights from professionals in leasing, ownership, and finance.

articles.title: OPEN Impact Arranges Coney Island Ground Lease for Charter School
articles.narrative: OPEN Impact Real Estate has arranged a 39-year leasehold condominium for Coney Island Preparatory Public Charter School, enabling the development of a new 45,190-square-foot high school at 773 Neptune Ave. in Brooklyn. This build-to-suit facility, constructed by Rybak Development, will allow the charter school to expand its high school enrollment to over 500 students and create new specialty instructional spaces. Occupancy is anticipated in summer 2027.

data_points.notable_features: Ground-up, build-to-suit facility for exclusive occupancy by the charter school.
data_points.project_notes: The new campus will allow the school to grow to serve more than 500 high school students, relocating its existing high school from 294 Avenue T in Gravesend.

articles.title: Fertility Provider Opens Clinic At 1900 Lawrence Office Tower: The Denver Deal Sheet
articles.narrative: Spring Fertility has signed a 15-year lease for 13,000 square feet at the 1900 Lawrence office tower in Denver. This transaction marks a significant commitment by the fertility provider to expand its presence in the market.

articles.title: Lineage Suing Solar Company Altus Power Over Boyle Heights Warehouse Fire
articles.narrative: Lineage is suing Altus Power and Pearce Services, alleging their negligence caused a warehouse fire in the Boyle Heights neighborhood of Los Angeles that burned for a week. The lawsuit claims the fire resulted from faulty solar panel installation and maintenance.

articles.title: Office Revenues Are Failing To Keep Pace With Expenses
articles.narrative: Office operating expenses are consistently outpacing revenue growth, leading to a decline in net operating income (NOI) for office properties. This trend, which has persisted since the pandemic, indicates a challenging financial environment for office landlords as rising costs continue to erode profitability.
articles.market_intelligence: Office operating expenses are exceeding revenue growth, impacting NOI. Rising costs persist post-pandemic.

articles.title: DFW Multifamily Distress Creates Opening For Investors As Development Slows
articles.narrative: The Dallas-Fort Worth multifamily market is experiencing a slowdown in new development, creating an opportune environment for investors to acquire distressed assets. This shift suggests a potential for value in older multifamily properties as market conditions evolve.
